<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if ( ! class_exists( 'WooCommerce' ) || ! class_exists( 'Starfiniti\Cart\Plugin' ) || ! Starfiniti\Cart\Plugin::instance()->is_ready() || 1 !== did_action( 'sfcart_loaded' ) ) {
    throw new RuntimeException( 'Starfiniti Cart did not initialize with WooCommerce.' );
}
$settings = get_option( 'sfcart_settings', array() );
if ( SFCART_VERSION !== get_option( 'sfcart_version' ) || '12' !== get_option( 'sfcart_db_version' ) || ! is_array( $settings ) || 12 !== ( $settings['settings_version'] ?? null ) || 365 !== ( $settings['analytics_retention_days'] ?? null ) || false !== ( $settings['delete_data_on_uninstall'] ?? null ) ) {
    throw new RuntimeException( 'Starfiniti Cart migrations did not complete safely.' );
}
require '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/starfiniti-cart/playground/setup.php';
file_put_contents( '/wordpress/wp-includes/css/sfcart-playground-ready.css', '/* WooCommerce and Starfiniti Cart are active. */' );
